issue.title: Decide whether x on a running agent should open a fate chooser
issue.description:
Proposed by land phase sase-1qz.11 (note #3) of epic sase-1qz (Agent Hijack, plan:202611/agent_hijack.md), which deferred an "x-as-fate-chooser" revisit.

Today `x` on a running agent opens ConfirmKillModal, which offers kill or **h Hijack instead** (src/sase/ace/tui/modals/confirm_kill_modal.py, _kill_action_flow.py), and `,k` hijacks directly. The open question from the research report: should `x` instead present a fate chooser (kill and release, hijack and keep the workspace, cancel) as the default stop UX, or keep the current explicit mapping? Assess with usage evidence, decide, and implement if the answer changes behaviour.

task_type_fields.proposal: Assess whether x on a running agent should present a kill / hijack / cancel fate chooser by default instead of the current kill confirmation with an h Hijack choice, and implement the decision.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The hijack epic kept x's meaning unchanged by design and added hijack as an opt-in choice; changing the default stop UX is a separate product decision.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1qz's land phase (sase-1qz.11) deferred revisiting x as a fate chooser now that hijack offers a keep-the-work stop.
